name: BriefRooms governed multi-instrument weekly paper exposure

strategy_tournament.rule: Select the highest-utility directional candidate using only earlier closed paper legs. The selected candidate is a proposal, not a forced trade: the NO_TRADE admission gate may abstain. Counterfactual observations of all candidates may reduce exploration uncertainty, but only realized selected-strategy legs drive the legacy global performance adjustment.

contextual_learning.rule: Learn separately for each instrument, strategy and matching market context. At every closed paper leg evaluate every candidate that was present at entry on the same entry-to-exit path. Do not change contextual utility until at least six earlier observations exist in the exact context. Apply Bayesian-style shrinkage and cap the contextual adjustment at +/-2 conviction points. Counterfactual samples reduce exploration uncertainty but never masquerade as realized selected-strategy PnL. Open frozen positions are never rewritten by learning.

eurusd_ma_structure.rule: Use W1 MA support/resistance as the primary structure signal, D1 price-vs-all-MAs as confirmation and H1 price-vs-all-MAs only as timing. H4 and M1 never veto a trade. The MA layer is a bounded context adjustment and never a standalone trade trigger.

macro_context.interpretation: Falling oil and falling US10Y support EUR/USD; rising oil and rising US10Y support the dollar. Inputs are normalized, capped and never used as standalone trade triggers.
macro_context.rule: The open position is not rewritten retroactively. Macro context enters new decisions and the governed 23:00 daily review.

no_trade.fallback_direction_rule: A default tie direction may rank a directional candidate, but it never overrides the NO_TRADE admission gate.
no_trade.rule: NO_TRADE is a first-class active state. A directional candidate is opened only when the admission thresholds are met; otherwise WES may keep monitoring for a later qualified trigger.

execution_integrity.rule: Every entry timestamp must be on or after the immutable decision timestamp.
